cat core/hooks/hooks.json && echo "=== DUR ===" && cat -n core/hooks/dur.js
cd core/hooks && echo "=== defter.short ===" && grep -n "^function short\|^function job\|^const LEDGER\|^function lastText" -A 22 defter.js | sed -n '1,80p'

cd core/hooks && grep -n "^function file\|^function sum\|^function handle" -A 18 count.js | head -70 && echo "=== kitap ===" && grep -n "^function audit\|^function turn\|^function entries\|^function transcript\|^function prompt" -A 10 kitap.js | head -70
